cardDesc: A ready-to-publish post for your page, written from your business info.
generatingHint: Preparing the text and image — this can take up to a minute.
takingLonger: This is taking longer than usual. Your post will appear here as soon as it is ready.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it manually.
includeContactToggle: Add your contact info to the post (address / phone / WhatsApp)
briefLabel: What should the post be about? (optional)
briefPlaceholder: e.g. the new makeup course starting this week, for beginners
imageRequestPlaceholder: e.g. a young woman in a hijab holding a notebook
askHint: Leave both empty and we'll pick the subject and the picture from your business info.
unmetRequestNotice: Not in your Business Info, so we left it out: {what}
unmetRequestCta: Add it to your Business Info
remaining: {count, plural, one {# attempt left today} other {# attempts left today}}
noRemaining: You've used today's attempts. You can create a new post tomorrow.
textOnlyNotice: The image couldn't be generated this time — the text is ready to use.
textOnlyStorageOff: Images are temporarily unavailable — the text is ready to use.
textOnlyRefused: The image you asked for couldn't be created — try describing the picture differently. The text is ready to use.
reviewBeforePosting: Review the post before publishing — you know your business best.
historyHint: Kept here with their text and images. Open any one to copy it.
errorDailyCap: Daily limit reached. You can create a new post tomorrow.
errorQuotaCheck: Couldn't verify your quota. Try again shortly.
errorGeneration: Something went wrong while writing the post. Try again.
errorRateLimit: Too many attempts in a short time. Try again in a minute.
